subject: Re: Regional GPU sourcing & onboarding playbook for Stratalytics commitment
messages:
From: Anna Moreno <anna@stratalytics.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated pools across US/EU/APAC — initial ask and timeline

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're finalizing the SOW and there is a hard requirement from our infra team to get dedicated GPU pools in US, EU, and APAC with predictable throughput and a documented onboarding timeline. High level asks: 

- Start: provisioning window for initial pools by 2026-09-15
- Capacity: ~120 A100-equivalent GPUs in US, 80 in EU, 40 in APAC to start; ability to burst +20% for 3 months.
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence and KMS integration for EU data at rest
- Pricing: committed monthly baseline with clear overage rates

Could you send a short playbook for how Redwood would source, reserve, and onboard these pools (including lead times, AZ placement, and acceptance criteria)? Procurement wants a single page they can include with the PO.

Anna
Anna Moreno
Head of Infra, Stratalytics
anna@stratalytics.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Anna Moreno <anna@stratalytics.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pools across US/EU/APAC — initial ask and timeline

Anna — appreciate the clear asks. Taking a run at a concise playbook and acceptance checklist; attaching a capacity worksheet so we can capture utilization assumptions and preferred AZs.

Quick answers up front:
- Lead times: US ~4–6 weeks, EU ~6–8 weeks (KMS + contract reviews add slack), APAC ~8–10 weeks (region setup + partner validation)
- Burst: we can provide +20% burst for the first 90 days via reserved burst nodes, subject to commit thresholds
- Compliance: will attach SOC2 evidence bundle and outline KMS options (customer-managed or Redwood-managed)

I'll loop Marcus for technical sizing and Laura for procurement language. Can we target a short call Friday to walk the PO language?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Anna Moreno <anna@stratalytics.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pools across US/EU/APAC — initial ask and timeline

Anna / team — attaching the filled capacity worksheet (capacity-worksheet-v2.xlsx). Notes from the sizing run: 

- Baseline assumptions: median seq len 256, avg tokens/sec 12 for generation workloads; p95 latency target 150ms on A100-equivalent SKUs.
- US pool: 120 GPUs maps to 6x24-GPU nodes (NVIDIA A100-80GB equivalent) to support sharded KV cache and high QPS.
- EU pool: recommend skew to 16-GPU nodes for AZ diversity (5 nodes ~= 80 GPUs).
- APAC pool: start with 4x10-GPU partner instances (40 GPUs) behind a regional gateway; verify container image signing and registry access during onboarding.

Onboarding milestones we typically include in the runbook:
1) PO & contract signed
2) Capacity reservation & AZ placement confirmed (T+7 business days)
3) Network peering & KMS setup (T+14–21)
4) Staging cluster smoke tests & perf validation (T+28–35)
5) Migration run & production cutover (T+42–60)

Open items: preferred AZs for EU (for data locality), whether Stratalytics will use customer-managed KMS, and any egress restrictions. If you can confirm, we will finalize the onboarding-runbook-draft.

—Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Anna Moreno <anna@stratalytics.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pools across US/EU/APAC — initial ask and timeline

Thanks Marcus — that breakdown is helpful. A few clarifications: 

- EU AZs: prefer eu-west-1a and eu-west-1b for latency to our Dublin fleet.
- KMS: we will use customer-managed KMS for EU and US; for APAC, we can use Redwood-managed until our HSM certs are in place.
- Burst: the +20% is acceptable but we need a 72-hour notice window for scheduled bursts; on-demand bursts are okay up to 5% without notice.

Procurement will draft the PO this week. Can Laura own the billing terms? Also attaching a procurement contact for CloudOps (procurement@cloudops.io) who will be copied into the PO.

Anna
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Anna Moreno <anna@stratalytics.ai>, Procurement <procurement@cloudops.io>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pools across US/EU/APAC — initial ask and timeline

Hi Anna and CloudOps team — Laura here (Billing & Contracts). Attaching a PO template (po-template-stratalytics.pdf) and a short one-page summary you can include with the PO describing lead times, acceptance criteria, and overage terms. Highlights: 

- Commit: monthly baseline and committed instance-hours; 30-day invoicing; prorated first month.
- Overage: billed at 1.5x baseline unit rate after burst quota consumed.
- SLA credits: per-node availability target 99.5% per month; credits limited to monthly service fees.
- Contract exceptions: KMS key custody language (we will accept customer-managed keys for EU/US).

Please let me know if the PO needs alternate billing contact or any additional fields.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Billing & Contracts, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Regional GPU sourcing & onboarding playbook (final)

Team — quick status update to close the loop before the PO lands: 

- Attachments: capacity-worksheet-v2.xlsx, onboarding-runbook-draft.md, po-template-stratalytics.pdf (all attached).
- Agreed timelines: US (T+4–6 weeks), EU (T+6–8 weeks, customer KMS steps required), APAC (T+8–10 weeks).
- Burst behavior: +20% for 90 days with 72-hour scheduled notice; 5% on-demand without notice.
- Next steps for Stratalytics: send signed PO, confirm EU AZ preferences (eu-west-1a/1b confirmed), provide KMS ARN(s).

Vivek — could you validate partner instance types in APAC and flag any supplier lead-time risk? Neha — can you prep SOC2 package and a short checklist we can share with procurement?

Anna — happy to jump on a 30-min call next week if you want to run the PO and timeline together.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
